title: Velvety Roasted Vietnamese Beef Pho Bo
description: A rich and flavorful Vietnamese dish featuring roasted beef, graham cracker crumbs, and a mother-sauce-base, all cooked in a cataplana vessel, dairy-free-friendly and perfect for a special occasion, this pho bo is a twist on the classic Vietnamese noodle soup
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced beef, graham cracker crumbs, grated ginger, and sliced onion
Add the star anise, cinnamon sticks, fish sauce, and soy sauce to the bowl and mix well
Transfer the mixture to a cataplana vessel and pour in the beef broth
Cover the vessel with a lid and roast in the preheated oven for 2 hours
Remove the vessel from the oven and stir in the rice noodles
Return the vessel to the oven and roast for an additional 30 minutes
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes
Serve the pho bo hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired
